fot_token_configured.meaning: a fee-on-transfer token is configured as the disputeToken

dispute_created.meaning: a user has called disputeTree() and sent disputeAmount tokens

fee_deducted_on_deposit.meaning: the FoT token deducted a transfer fee so the contract received less than disputeAmount

resolution_completes.meaning: resolveDispute() completes successfully and clears the disputer for the valid dispute

recovery_via_recover_or_deposit_possible.meaning: recoverERC20() or depositing more tokens can restore the ability to resolve the dispute (only upgrade/migration can recover)

assumptions: The dispute is valid and the disputer is an honest user, not an attacker.
The 1000/990 figures are illustrative examples, not asserted observed values.
resolveDispute() is the only function that clears the disputer.

unresolved.description: Report does not give numeric received/recorded amounts or a numeric definition of the recovery relation; the no-recovery claim is represented as a grounded Boolean over recoverERC20/deposit ineffectiveness.

limitations: The no-recovery impact is encoded as a Boolean because the report states the qualitative claim that recoverERC20 and further deposits cannot help, without numeric operands.
Whether resolveDispute(true) or resolveDispute(false) is attempted first is not specified and is not needed for this claim.
